_note: Hand-tuned layer on top of the scraped brand.json (maharishistore.com, Shopify). Run: python3 tools/build_brand.py --rebuild maharishi. Hand-picked images in assets/brand/ are crops of the site's own homepage images (AW26 Thailand jungle hero, Outerwear and Trousers tiles, the Maharishi AW26 journal banner, 'The Names Are Many, The Truth Is One' 30th anniversary shoot). Logos are the lowercase 'maharishi' wordmark from the site header SVG.

scrape._extraCollections: The site's menu is rendered by JS (static parse found none); these are its collections.

returns.summary: Register returns on our returns portal within 14 days of delivery and choose a refund, exchange or credit; you then have a further 14 days to send the goods back, unworn, with all original tags and branded packaging.

_rewards: Maharishi has no loyalty programme. The template's Account rewards card is kept as an illustrative app concept (same as the yelir reference build) and its fine print says so; it never claims a real scheme.
_discount: The site's sign-up offers 10% off a first order (code emailed, not public). The app pop-up uses the same 10% with a placeholder app code.
